definitions.explanation: Publishing a book or other work independently, without going through a traditional publishing house. The author handles or arranges editing, design, printing, and distribution.

examples.japanese: {自己出版|じこしゅっぱん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I published a book through self-publishing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電子書籍|でんししょせき}→電子書籍：16435_denshishoseki⟧なら{自己出版|じこしゅっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ハードル→ハードル：11117_haadoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The barrier to self-publishing is low with e-books.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{自己出版|じこしゅっぱん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}→写真集：19947_shashinshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people are building a following on social media and then self-publishing photo books.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) and ⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧ (publishing). In Japan, self-publishing has traditionally been done through ⟦{自費出版|じひしゅっぱん}→自費出版：23968_jihishuppan⟧ (paying out of pocket for a publisher's services), but {自己出版|じこしゅっぱん} has come to refer more specifically to the modern model where the author handles everything independently, especially through digital platforms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己出版|じこしゅっぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to self-publish
- {自己出版|じこしゅっぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}: self-published book
- ⟦{電子書籍|でんししょせき}→電子書籍：16435_denshishoseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自己出版|じこしゅっぱん}: e-book self-publishing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自費出版|じひしゅっぱん}→自費出版：23968_jihishuppan⟧: vanity publishing — paying a publisher to produce your book; the traditional Japanese model
- ⟦{商業出版|しょうぎょうしゅっぱん}→商業出版：26541_shougyoushuppan⟧: commercial publishing — the publisher bears costs and selects manuscripts
- ⟦{同人誌|どうじんし}→同人誌：07326_doujinshi⟧: doujinshi — self-published fan works or indie magazines, a major Japanese subculture
